sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 10:82

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 10:82:1
items.html: From Keter to Hochma, and from Hochma to Bina, and from Bina to Tifferet, and from Tifferet to Malchut, etc.: For although there are ten Sefirot in every Partzuf, there are nevertheless only five discernments of coupling there, which are the five known discernments in the screen. For HGT-NHY are all only one discernment of coarseness, namely phase one, as is known.
